qco.title: Domestic Pressure Cookers (Quality Control) Order, 2020
qco.scope: Mandatory BIS certification under DPIIT Order S.O. 371(E). All domestic pressure cookers manufactured, imported, or sold in India must conform to IS 2347 and bear the Standard Mark (ISI mark).
exemptions: Goods or articles meant exclusively for export are exempt from this Order.
requirements: Mandatory BIS certification under Scheme-I (ISI Mark) under IS 2347.
Verification of thermal and pressure relief safety mechanisms and burst pressure test compliance.
Prohibition of manufacture, import, sale, distribution, storage, or exhibition without valid BIS Licence.
